verdict.rationale: Fivetran documents choosing a cloud provider (GCP, AWS, Azure) and offers a Hybrid Deployment model that can keep processing within a customer's own environment, which implies some control over where data resides, but there is no explicit documentation of selectable data regions or residency guarantees for the managed SaaS destination processing itself. Missing for 10: explicit region-selection UI/API docs, formal data residency/compliance statements, and confirmation of which regions are supported.
